transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Name]. Can you tell me what brings you in today?
I… I’ve been losing my temper. More than normal. Like, I yelled at one of my employees for putting stock on the wrong shelf, and afterward I was shaking. I don’t usually treat people like that.
Have you experienced episodes like this before, or is this the first time you’ve had such a strong emotional reaction?

I’ve been irritated before, sure, but… not like this. The blowing up over nothing, shaking afterward—that feels new. Like with the stock on the wrong shelf, I just snapped. I don’t usually act that way.
Has anything else been bothering you lately, like trouble sleeping, feeling down, or being overly worried about things?
I don’t know… nothing specific, I guess. I just feel off, but I haven’t really been keeping track of all that.
Have you felt down, sad, or lost interest in things you usually enjoy, even a little bit?
I’m… not really sure. I haven’t noticed losing interest exactly. I guess I just haven’t been paying much attention to that.
Have you had any recent periods where you felt unusually energetic, upbeat, or needed less sleep than usual?
No… I don’t think so. I haven’t felt unusually upbeat or anything like that. Sleep’s been… I don’t know, but not because I had extra energy.
Have you noticed feeling down, hopeless, or experiencing less pleasure in things you used to enjoy, even a little bit?
I’m not sure. I mean… I wouldn’t say hopeless exactly. I haven’t really been paying attention to whether things feel enjoyable or not.
Have you noticed that things you usually enjoy feel less pleasurable lately?
I don’t really know. I haven’t… noticed that specifically. Things just feel kind of beside the point lately, I guess.
Have you found that activities you usually enjoy, like hobbies or time with friends, feel less satisfying or enjoyable lately?
I guess… I haven’t really thought about it that way. I’m not sure if they feel less enjoyable, exactly. I just haven’t been doing much of that lately.
Have you found that activities you usually enjoy, like hobbies or time with friends, feel less satisfying or enjoyable lately?
I don’t know… maybe. I haven’t really been seeing people or doing hobbies much, so it’s hard to tell if they’d feel satisfying or not.
Have you lost interest in most activities, even ones you used to enjoy, like work, hobbies, or spending time with people?
I’m not sure I’d say “most.” I’ve just kind of… stepped back from things. I haven’t really been checking whether I enjoy them or not.
Have you noticed that you’ve lost interest in most activities, even things you used to enjoy, like work, hobbies, or being around people?
I don’t really know. I haven’t been doing much, so… it’s hard to say if I’ve lost interest or just haven’t felt up to getting into things.
Have you felt like things you usually care about or enjoy just don’t matter to you anymore?
I don’t know… I wouldn’t put it that way. I just haven’t really been paying attention to what matters right now.
Have you noticed that things you usually enjoy feel less pleasurable or rewarding lately?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t been paying much attention to whether things feel good or not… I just haven’t been doing much of them.
Can you think of something you used to really enjoy—like a hobby, a TV show, or time with a friend—and whether it would feel as good to do that now as it used to?
I don’t know… I can’t really picture it. I haven’t tried, and I’m not sure I’d be able to tell right now.
Can you think of a specific activity or situation that you used to enjoy or look forward to, and if you did it now, do you think you’d still enjoy it or feel anything from it?
I don’t really know. I can think of things I used to do, but… I haven’t wanted to try them, so I can’t say if I’d enjoy it or not.

Can you think of a specific time in the past when you enjoyed spending time with someone close to you, and if you were to spend time with them now, do you think you’d still feel that enjoyment or it wouldn’t really affect you either way?
I… I can think of times, yeah, but I don’t really know how it would feel now. I haven’t really tried being around people like that lately, so I can’t say if I’d enjoy it or just feel nothing.

If you did something you used to really enjoy—like a hobby, seeing a friend, or watching a favorite show—do you think you’d still feel any pleasure or satisfaction from it, or would it feel like it didn’t really matter?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really done any of those things lately, so I don’t know if it would feel good or just… not really matter.
Have you completely lost interest in things you used to care about, like work, hobbies, or seeing people, to the point where nothing really seems to matter or make a difference?
I don’t know if it’s that complete. I just… haven’t really been doing much or checking whether I care. It’s hard to tell.
Have you, at any point recently, felt like nothing really matters anymore—not work, not people, not things you used to care about—and that you just don’t care about anything?
I don’t know… I don’t think I’d put it that strongly. I’ve been kind of shut down, but I can’t really say nothing matters or that I don’t care about anything.
Have you, in the past two weeks, felt that you've lost interest or pleasure in most activities, even ones you used to enjoy?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t been doing much, so I can’t say if I’ve lost pleasure in most things.
